title: Registered Practical Nurse
summary: Registered Practical Nurses give hands-on nursing care to patients, often working alongside Registered Nurses and other health professionals.

scopeOfPractice.description: Not yet verified. The official scope of practice will be summarized here from the College of Nurses of Ontario.

typicalDuties: Check and record patients' health status
Help patients with daily care and comfort
Teach patients and families about their care

teamConnections.how: Work together on hospital units caring for patients who have trouble breathing.

exams.name: REx-PN
eligibilityPrereqs: Graduate of an approved practical nursing program

steps: Apply to the College of Nurses of Ontario

title: Respiratory Therapist
summary: Respiratory Therapists help people who have trouble breathing, from newborns to older adults, often in hospitals and critical care.

scopeOfPractice.description: Not yet verified. The official scope of practice will be summarized here from the College of Respiratory Therapists of Ontario.

typicalDuties: Assess patients' breathing and lung function
Set up and manage breathing equipment such as ventilators
Teach patients how to manage lung conditions

teamConnections.how: Work together on hospital units caring for patients who have trouble breathing.

exams.name: CBRC exam
eligibilityPrereqs: Graduate of an accredited respiratory therapy program

steps: Apply to the College of Respiratory Therapists of Ontario

title: Medical Laboratory Technologist
summary: Medical Laboratory Technologists test blood, tissue, and other samples in the lab so doctors and nurses can diagnose and treat patients.

scopeOfPractice.description: Not yet verified. The official scope of practice will be summarized here from the College of Medical Laboratory Technologists of Ontario.

typicalDuties: Run tests on blood, urine, and tissue samples
Operate and check automated lab analyzers
Make sure results are accurate before they are reported
Follow strict safety and quality steps

teamConnections.how: Nurses collect many of the samples that lab technologists test, and act on the results.

exams.name: National entry-to-practice exam for medical laboratory technologists
eligibilityPrereqs: Graduate of an accredited medical laboratory science program

steps: Apply to the College of Medical Laboratory Technologists of Ontario

title: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Technologist
summary: MRI Technologists use powerful magnets and computers to take detailed pictures of the inside of the body, and keep patients safe and comfortable during scans.

scopeOfPractice.description: Not yet verified. The official scope of practice will be summarized here from the College of Medical Radiation and Imaging Technologists of Ontario.

typicalDuties: Screen patients for MRI safety (for example, metal implants)
Position patients and run MRI scans
Adjust scan settings to get clear images
Explain the scan and help patients stay calm and still

teamConnections.how: Nurses help prepare and monitor patients who need an MRI, especially patients admitted to hospital.

exams.name: CAMRT certification exam (Magnetic Resonance)
exams.administeredBy: Canadian Association of Medical Radiation Technologists
eligibilityPrereqs: Graduate of an accredited MRI program

steps: Apply to the College of Medical Radiation and Imaging Technologists of Ontario
